_comment: Instance family → GPU driver version mapping for SageMaker inference fleet. Source: AWS docs (inference-gpu-drivers.html) + empirical validation. Updated quarterly or when AWS announces fleet driver updates.

g7._source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/inference-gpu-drivers.html (ml.g7.* / ml.g7e.* default row: driver 580, CUDA 13.0, al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1). AWS publishes the driver major only (580).

g7e._source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/inference-gpu-drivers.html (ml.g7.* / ml.g7e.* default row: driver 580, CUDA 13.0, al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1). AWS publishes the driver major only (580).

p6-b200._source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/inference-gpu-drivers.html (driver/CUDA/AMI: ml.p6.* default row); https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/instancetypes/ac.html (GPU model + per-GPU memory). AWS publishes the driver major only (580).

p6-b300._source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/inference-gpu-drivers.html (driver/CUDA/AMI: ml.p6.* default row); https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/instancetypes/ac.html (GPU model + per-GPU memory). AWS publishes the driver major only (580).

ami_versions._comment: InferenceAmiVersion enum → driver version mapping (SDK enum + empirical) and, per AMI, the AWS compatibility allow-list (BL209). default_families = the 'Instance types (default)' column, override_families = the 'Compatible instance types with AMI version overrides' column of the Real-time and Asynchronous Inference rows (identical for both services) at https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/inference-gpu-drivers.html. Families are SageMaker family names without the ml. prefix; AWS writes ml.p6.* for the P6 families (p6-b200, p6-b300). servers/lib/image-filter.js resolveInferenceAmi() reads these lists; a family listed under neither column is not AWS-supported for that AMI. The driver-470 / CUDA 11.4 row has no AMI version name (it is the platform default for p4d, p4de, g4dn, g5), so it has no entry here.

al2-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-2-1._source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/inference-gpu-drivers.html (driver 535 / CUDA 12.2 row, which names gpu-2 and gpu-2-1 together; Real-time + Asynchronous; retrieved 2026-10-26)

al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1._source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/APIReference/API_ProductionVariant.html (InferenceAmiVersion enum) + https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/inference-gpu-drivers.html (driver 580 / CUDA 13.0 row, Real-time + Asynchronous; AWS writes ml.p6.*; retrieved 2026-10-26). AWS publishes the driver major only (580).

cuda_to_min_driver._comment: CUDA toolkit version → minimum required driver (Linux data center). Source: NVIDIA CUDA compatibility docs. 13.0: https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-toolkit-release-notes/index.html (CUDA 13.0 → driver branch R580; CUDA 13.x minor-version compatibility needs driver >= 580).
